title: VIXEN preset places the build tree above VIXEN but the invocation shape is easy to get wrong
body: The documented vixen-wsl preset configured successfully, but cmake --build build/wsl from the VIXEN worktree failed because the preset writes its binary tree at ../build/wsl. The successful queued workaround was cmake --build ../build/wsl. The preset/validation workflow should expose or normalize the build directory so the standard command from VIXEN is valid.

title: VIXEN lane lacks a usable CodeGraph index for repository exploration
body: The mandated CodeGraph-first query reported no .codegraph index for this VIXEN worktree, so locating the merged-SDI generator required the fallback search workflow. The repository setup should publish or rebuild the CodeGraph index for assigned worktrees, or provide an explicit supported fallback in the lane tooling.
